newsitem.title: USA: Grossman's names interim president, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Grossman's names interim president, CEO.

text.p: Grossman's Inc said on Monday that its directors had elected Thomas Arnold Jr as interim president and chief executive, replacing Seymour Kroll, who resigned effective today.
Arnold will also continue to be the person principally responsible for Grossman's reorganization effort and its related Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceedings, the company said.
In addition, Grossman's said that Dirck Iacobelli will assume the responsibilities of acting executive vice president and chief financial officer of the company.

Arnold, 52, recently served as chairman of the board of trustees of three separate trusts handling assets of Executive Life Insurance Co. He also served as court-appointed chairman of the board, chief executive officer and president of American Continental Corp. Arnold was appointed to that post after the resignation of Charles Keating in conformance with a confirmed reorganization plan.
Iacobelli, 48, has been a financial consultant to troubled companies since 1986 and has worked closely with Arnold on a number of assignments, Grossman's said.
Grossman's Inc operates 15 stores under the name Contractors' Warehouse.
